exact_statement.state_markov_bridge: For every normalized finite Gibbs density or evolved history vector and every site, (n-1)^5 times the top-level probability is at most the corresponding expectation of N^5; the audit checks this exact finite-state inequality.
exact_statement.energy_comparison: The audit also reports the finite ratio omega(N^5)/(1+omega(k_h^5)) for the shifted onsite k_h used by R-167. These ratios are diagnostic finite values, not a volume-, cutoff-, source-, beta-, orientation-, or history-uniform theorem.
exact_statement.qft_interface: This instantiates the scalar R279 input for actual finite Q3 states before any CCR transfer, but it does not prove the unbounded common-core limit, common-alpha dynamics, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, Sector A or Pre-A.
exact_statement.scope_firewall: Zero source, volumes 2 and 4, declared oscillator dimensions, beta, times, and both cutoff orientations only. No thermodynamic or regulator-uniform conclusion is inferred.

lean_crosscheck.role: R279 supplies the scalar fifth-moment-to-weighted-tail implication; this package supplies actual finite Q3 state moments but does not formalize matrix exponentials or uniform limits.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite actual-state bridge. It validates the top-tail Markov inequality for the declared Q3 Gibbs and history fixtures and reports finite N^5-to-k_h^5 ratios. It does not establish any uniform Q3 estimate or QFT reconstruction.
